output.attribution_rationale: The randomized source comparison used the same CBT course and crossed expectancy conditions, comparing psychologist-reviewed AI feedback with human-written feedback.

achieved_dates.note: The entry has no achieved dates; results date screening to August 2025–April 2026 but give no calendar dates for treatment or outcome collection.

conflict.note: The source and entry disclose Carlbring’s OpenAI honoraria and two authors’ journal editorships.

tests.note: Calendar dates for treatment outcomes are not established by the screening dates; evidence A is also unverified because registration was retrospective, and the other evidence categories do not fit this randomized trial.

output.summary: The source supports 263 randomized adults and an inconclusive AI-minus-human difference of 1.15 SPIN points, with non-inferiority unestablished. It does not establish prospective endpoint registration or calendar dates for the measured outcomes.
